rounds.text: Ultramarine & Pigments Ltd is trading at an attractive valuation with a P/E of just 13.3x and a price-to-book ratio of 1.38x [E1, E2]. A discounted cash flow model establishes an intrinsic value of Rs 576 per share against the current market price of Rs 411, offering a substantial margin of safety of 28.7% [E36, E37]. Furthermore, the reverse DCF indicates that the current price merely prices in a modest 2.3% earnings growth, whereas the base case anticipates 7.0% [E38]. Momentum and fundamentals are also aligning favorably, with the rules-based screen scoring the stock at 79 out of 100 with a BUY rating, alongside positive institutional money flow [E35, E52]. The financial foundation is exceptionally secure, featuring a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.10x, borrowings reduced to Rs 86 Cr, and robust operating cash flow reaching Rs 128 Cr in March 2026 [E26, E29, E30]. Conceded: ROE sits at a modest 8.6% with a 5-year median of 8%, showing lower capital efficiency than headline growth rates might suggest [E7, E18].
